title: MCP invalid_argument errors lack the reminders and next every tool error is documented to carry
outcome: MCP invalid_argument errors lack the reminders and next every tool error is documented to carry
acceptance: An MCP invalid_argument error (src/mcp.rs invalid_argument, returned by ordinary-mode update) carries error.reminders and error.next like the verb errors, or docs/features/cli-and-mcp.md narrows its claims that every tool error adds those two fields (the Read-only mode section and the general error paragraph) to the errors that do; a test pins the shape.

completion.summary: MCP invalid_argument errors (update's seven refused argument combinations) now carry error.reminders (the reason) and error.next (empty, as the verb guidance fallback gives a refusal with no specific remedy), so every Engram-built MCP tool error has both fields. A unit test pins all seven combinations, and the stdio dogfood test checks a real refusal. Landed 1ddded7. Round 1 was clean; rmcp's own argument errors are filed separately as w-50992fc0da41. Full gate test-5fe4b396 passed 9/9; the independent evaluation passed 1/1.
